fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Deploy IMSI catcher detection rules with NAS-EMM unmasked value thresholds >120.
Enable 5G NAS security mode enforcement for all UE attachments.
Configure RAN to block unknown IMSI attachments without valid authentication.
Implement NAS trace monitoring for repeated unmasked value anomalies.
Set up a KPI for NAS-EMM unmasked value spikes in high-risk areas.
Deploy NAS-based IMSI blacklisting for known rogue devices.
Enforce NAS security context validation for all TAU/ATT attempts.
Enable 5G core network logging for NAS-EMM unmasked value events.
Set a counter for failed NAS security mode rejections per UE.
Update RAN to reject NAS messages with unmasked values >120.
